comparison.objective: Apply, smooth, and rapidly peel a cold-wax strip from a practice form; the candidate configures rigid gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-sheet smoothing, adhesion management, and low-angle peeling, not rigid two-tool torque control.
comparison.success_condition: At least 70% application followed by complete release, with full credit for a peel within 2 s and damage/angle exclusions; candidate tests locked angular retention.
comparison.reason: The deformable adhesion task has no meaningful ability-level overlap with stop-screw locking.
